(raw_price_amount > 0 AND zero_price_reason_code IS NULL) OR (raw_price_amount = 0 AND ((quality_status = 'VERIFIED' AND zero_price_reason_code IN ('CONTRACTUAL_FREE_OF_CHARGE','PROMOTIONAL_FREE_OF_CHARGE','FREE_SAMPLE','BUNDLED_NO_SEPARATE_PRICE','FULL_REBATE_OR_CREDIT')) OR (quality_status IN ('UNVERIFIED','UNIT_ERROR') AND (zero_price_reason_code IS NULL OR zero_price_reason_code IN ('CONTRACTUAL_FREE_OF_CHARGE','PROMOTIONAL_FREE_OF_CHARGE','FREE_SAMPLE','BUNDLED_NO_SEPARATE_PRICE','FULL_REBATE_OR_CREDIT'))) OR (quality_status = 'REJECTED' AND (zero_price_reason_code IS NULL OR zero_price_reason_code IN ('CONTRACTUAL_FREE_OF_CHARGE','PROMOTIONAL_FREE_OF_CHARGE','FREE_SAMPLE','BUNDLED_NO_SEPARATE_PRICE','FULL_REBATE_OR_CREDIT','SOURCE_PLACEHOLDER')))))
(quality_status = 'VERIFIED' AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verification_evidence <> '{}'::jsonb) OR (quality_status <> 'VERIFIED' AND verified_by_user_id IS NULL AND verified_at IS NULL)
updated_at >= created_at AND (verified_at IS NULL OR (verified_at >= observed_at AND verified_at <= updated_at))
